dataset.v: 五个数据集，包含人体器官与体模数据
dataset.excerpt: We conduct experiments on five datasets containing human organ and phantom data. Details are listed in Table 1.

dataset.v: 公开人体器官 CT 数据集 [4,12]，包括 chest、jaw、foot、abdomen；chest 来自 LIDC-IDRI [4]，其余来自 Open Scientific Visualization Datasets [12]
dataset.excerpt: We evaluate our method using public datasets of human organ CTs [4,12], including chest, jaw, foot and abdomen. The chest data are from LIDC-IDRI dataset [4], and the rest are from Open Scientific Visualization Datasets [12].

dataset.k: 人体器官投影生成方式
dataset.v: 由于数据集仅提供体 CT，使用断层工具箱 TIGRE [5] 生成投影
dataset.excerpt: Since these datasets only provide volumetric CT scans, we generate projections by a tomographic toolbox TIGRE [5].

dataset.v: 用 GE C-arm Medical System 扫描硅主动脉体模采集
dataset.excerpt: We collect a phantom dataset by scanning a silicon aortic phantom with GE C-arm Medical System.

dataset.v: 用内置算法生成 512×512×510 CT 图像作为 ground truth
dataset.excerpt: A 512×512×510 CT image is also generated with inbuilt algorithms as the ground truth.

acquisition.excerpt: In TIGRE [5], we capture 50 projections with 3% noise in the range of 180◦.
In TIGRE [5], we capture 50 projections with 3% noise in the range of 180◦.

acquisition.v: position primary angle 从 -103° 到 93°，position secondary angle 为 0°
acquisition.excerpt: This system captures 582 500×500 fluoroscopy projections with position primary angle from -103◦to 93◦and position secondary angle of 0◦.
This system captures 582 500×500 fluoroscopy projections with position primary angle from -103◦to 93◦and position secondary angle of 0◦.
We only use 50 projections for experiments.

acquisition.v: 每条射线采样点数取决于 CT 数据尺寸；例如 128×128×128 chest CT 每条射线采样 192 点
acquisition.excerpt: The sampling quantity of each ray depends on the size of CT data. For example, we sample 192 points along each ray for the 128×128×128 chest CT.

acquisition.v: 分层采样，将射线分为 N 个等距 bin，每个 bin 均匀采样一点
acquisition.excerpt: A stratified sampling method [13] is adopted, where we divide a ray into N evenly spaced bins and uniformly sample one point at each bin.

training.excerpt: Our proposed method is implemented in PyTorch [17].
We use Adam optimizer with a learning rate that starts at 1 ×10−3 and steps down to 1 ×10−4.
We use Adam optimizer with a learning rate that starts at 1 ×10−3 and steps down to 1 ×10−4.
The batch size is 2048 rays at each iteration.
All experiments are conducted on a single RTX 3090 GPU.

training.v: 与 [14] 使用相同超参数设置；更多超参数细节见补充材料
training.excerpt: We use the same hyper-parameter setting for hash encoder as [14]. More details of hyper-parameters can be found in the supplementary material.
Compared with frequency encoder, hash encoder produces much smaller outputs (32 in our setting) with competitive feature quality for two reasons.

training.v: 4 个全连接层；前三层 32 通道宽，中间 ReLU 激活；最后一层 1 个神经元接 sigmoid；含 skip connection 将网络输入拼接到第二层激活
training.excerpt: the network is composed of 4 fully-connected layers. The first three layers are 32-channel wide and have ReLU activation functions in between, while the last layer has one neuron followed by a sigmoid activation. A skip connection is included to concatenate the network input to the second layer’s activation.

training.v: 10-40 分钟重建详细 CT 模型
training.excerpt: our method can reconstruct a detailed CT model within 10-40 minutes, which is comparable to iterative methods.

loss.v: 真实投影与合成投影之间的 L2 损失
loss.excerpt: NAF is updated by minimizing the L2 loss between real and synthesized projections.

loss.v: L(Θ,Φ) = Σ_{r∈B} ‖Ir(r)−Is(r)‖2，B 为 ray batch，Ir 与 Is 分别为真实与合成投影
loss.excerpt: L(Θ,Φ) = r∈B ∥Ir (r)−Is(r)∥2 , (3) where B is a ray batch, and Ir and Is are real and synthesized projections for ray r respectively.

baselines.excerpt: FDK [7] is firstly chosen as a representative of analytical methods.
The second method SART [2] is a robust iterative reconstruction algorithm.

baselines.v: 带 total-variation 正则化的迭代方法 [20]
baselines.excerpt: ASD-POCS [20] is another iterative method with a total-variation regularizer.

baselines.v: 实现 IntraTomo [28] 的 CBCT 变体，作为频率编码深度学习方法示例
baselines.excerpt: We implement a CBCT variant of IntraTomo [28], named IntraTomo3D, as an example of frequency-encoding deep learning methods.

metrics.excerpt: We evaluate five methods quantitatively in terms of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PNSR) and structural similarity (SSIM) [25].

metrics.v: PSNR (dB) 统计评估伪影抑制性能
metrics.excerpt: PSNR (dB) statistically assesses the artifact suppression performance, while SSIM measures the perceptual difference between two signals.

metrics.v: 衡量两个信号之间的感知差异
metrics.excerpt: PSNR (dB) statistically assesses the artifact suppression performance, while SSIM measures the perceptual difference between two signals.

metrics.v: PSNR/SSIM 越高表示重建越准确
metrics.excerpt: Higher PNSR/SSIM values represent the accurate reconstruction and vice versa.

results.k: Abdomen PSNR 相对第二好方法提升
results.v: 比第二好的 SART 高 3.07 dB
results.excerpt: For example, the PSNR value of our method in the abdomen dataset is 3.07 dB higher than that of the second-best method SART.

results.v: IntraTomo3D 训练超过一小时；NAF 与迭代方法耗时相近，比 IntraTomo3D 快 3 倍
results.excerpt: IntraTomo3D requires more than one hour to train the network. Benefiting from the compact network design, NAF spends similar running time to iterative methods and is 3×faster than the frequency-encoding deep learning method IntraTomo3D.
